description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Order that no Medical Test Laboratory of a Hospital or a Medical Test Laboratory Center shall charge, or levy any charges or fees
reasoning: This gazette notification contains a regulatory order issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It establishes maximum pricing regulations for specific medical laboratory tests (PCR and RAT), which constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement. While it includes a named individual (Maj. Gen. Shantha Dissanayake) in a signing capacity, this does not constitute a government personnel appointment or change, and the core content is regulatory in nature, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette.
